features: Project chats with no explicit selection route graph questions before normal solvers; explicit file selections retain their semantics.
Cross-file agreement percentages count recorded checks, with a complete mismatch table and citations in both files.
Evidence-backed connections and appearances include matching items and sheet references.
engine.kg.impact traverses physical dependencies and equivalent appearances without changing source data.
Impact summaries deduplicate equivalent records; conditional full-face lining areas, service run lengths and door-height checks retain source proof.
Confidence is the exact minimum of the used graph edge confidences; missing links are explicit and cost zero.

real_questions.truth_scope: Independent IFC relationships and existing CAD geometry; checks graph reasoning over indexes, not raster detection accuracy.

real_questions.accuracy_caveat: Three unseen structural-wall impact cases have no independent positive dependency gold; they test graceful sparse-data handling/schema/confidence only. The 30/30 figure is a check pass rate, not a claim of 100% drawing-answer accuracy.

limitations: No link does not prove no effect; all impact rows are potential effects, not code-compliance or clash guarantees.
Wall lining changes assume a full wall face follows the ceiling; openings, room coverage, layers and waste require checking. Unknown dimensional uncertainty is not replaced by an arbitrary margin.
Whole service-run lengths are distinguished from length inside a room. Conflicting ceiling heights suppress quantity calculations.
PDF extraction is outside this row; existing optional graph readers and source-backed room_ceiling_notes hook are consumed when available.
